title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Kirk Cousins tosses two touchdowns in Week 10 win over Packers
items.desc: Kirk Cousins completed 21-of-31 pass attempts for 207 yards, two touchdowns, and one interception while also rushing three times for 11 yards in the Vikings' 30-10 Week 10 win over the Packers.
items.impact: Cousins continues a steady stretch behind center, tossing two or more touchdowns in eight of his 10 games. The veteran signal-caller looks to offer head coach Kevin O'Connell more reliable quarterback play after being traded from Las Vegas, with a tough Week 11 matchup against the San Francisco 49ers up next.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Justin Jefferson leads pass-catchers in Week 10 win over Packers
items.desc: Justin Jefferson hauled in nine of his team-leading 13 targets for 74 yards in the Vikings' 30-10 Week 10 win over the Packers.
items.impact: Jefferson took advantage of the return of quarterback Kirk Cousins behind center, recording over 70 receiving yards for the second time in his last five games. The superstar wideout will look to return to his dynamic WR1 form with more competent quarterback play behind center ahead of a Week 11 matchup against the San Francisco 49ers.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jordan Mason leads backfield in Week 10 win over Packers
items.desc: Jordan Mason carried the ball 16 times for 59 yards while failing to catch his only target in the Vikings' 30-10 Week 10 win over the Packers.
items.impact: Mason has struggled to find room out of the Minnesota backfield to this point, totaling less than 60 offensive yards in four of his five games. The running back remains part of an underperforming Minnesota backfield alongside Aaron Jones Sr. entering a Week 11 matchup against the San Francisco 49ers.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Aaron Jones Sr. reaches end zone in Week 10 win over Packers
items.desc: Aaron Jones Sr. rushed 11 times for 47 yards and one touchdown while also hauling in his only target for eight yards in the Vikings' 30-10 Week 10 win over the Packers.
items.impact: Jones Sr. has cooled off out of the backfield of late, recording under 100 offensive yards in each of his last four contests. The running back remains difficult to trust while sharing backfield work with Jordan Mason for the Vikings ahead of a Week 11 matchup against the San Francisco 49ers.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Gavin Bartholomew catches touchdown in Week 10
items.desc: Gavin Bartholomew caught three of his four targets for 36 yards and one touchdown in the Vikings' 30-10 win over the Packers in Week 10.
items.impact: Bartholomew has struggled to make an impact in the Minnesota offense to this point, recording four or more targets for the second time in nine games. The tight end can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 11 contest against the San Francisco 49ers.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Myles Price finds end zone in Week 10 win
items.desc: Myles Price hauled in each of his four targets for 49 yards and one touchdown while also rushing once for 12 yards in the Vikings' 30-10 win over the Packers in Week 10.
items.impact: Price made the most of increased targets, finishing with more than three receptions while recording a touchdown for the first time this season in the win. The wideout could be in line for increased usage with WR2 Jordan Addison fighting through injury issues ahead of a Week 11 contest against the San Francisco 49ers.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Tai Felton sees five targets in Week 10 win
items.desc: Tai Felton caught three of his five targets for 33 yards in the Vikings' 30-10 win over the Packers in Week 10.
items.impact: Felton has struggled to make an impact in the Minnesota offense to this point, recording under 35 receiving yards in each of his nine contests. The wideout can be left off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 11 contest against the San Francisco 49ers.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Ben Yurosek catches pass in Week 10
items.desc: Ben Yurosek caught his only target for seven yards in the Vikings' 30-10 win over the Packers in Week 10.
items.impact: Yurosek has made minimal impact in the Minnesota offense to this point, recording one reception or less in each of his five games. The tight end can be left off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 11 contest against the San Francisco 49ers.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Max Bredeson sees one target in Week 10
items.desc: Max Bredeson failed to catch his only target in the Vikings' 30-10 win over the Packers in Week 10.
items.impact: Bredeson has been a non-factor in the Minnesota offense to this point, failing to log a touch in each of his 10 games. The fullback can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 11 contest against the San Francisco 49ers.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Vikings D/ST wreaks havoc in Week 10
items.desc: The Vikings D/ST registered eight sacks while also forcing four turnovers (one interception, three fumble recoveries) in a 30-10 win over the Packers in Week 10.
items.impact: The defense turned in another impactful performance Sunday, allowing just 220 offensive yards while consistently disrupting the Green Bay offense in the win. The unit will look to offer another dynamic performance for fantasy managers against a prolific San Francisco 49ers offense in Week 11.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Will Reichard racks up 12 points in Week 10
items.desc: Will Reichard converted all three of his field goal attempts as well as each of his three extra point attempts to finish with 12 points in the Vikings' 30-10 win over the Packers in Week 10.
items.impact: Reichard continues a dynamic stretch to this point, recording six or more points in eight of his nine contests. The kicker will look to offer fantasy managers another impactful performance in a difficult Week 11 contest against the San Francisco 49ers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Lucas Patrick remains in concussion protocol
items.desc: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn said Lucas Patrick remains in concussion protocol.
items.impact: Patrick did not play last Thursday due to the concussion. His status remains uncertain heading into Week 11.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jordan Burch (MCL) out for season
items.desc: Cardinals coach Mike LaFleur said LB Jordan Burch will miss the rest of the season with the MCL injury he suffered Sunday against the Rams.
items.impact: Burch totaled 19 tackles and one sack on the season in his second year in the NFL.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Andrew Wingard (wrist/hand) to miss extended time
items.desc: Arizona S Andrew Wingard will miss an "extended period of time" with a wrist/hand injury.
items.impact: Wingard may be a candidate to be placed on injured reserve.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Sauce Gardner (calf) dealing with calf injury
items.desc: Colts head coach Shane Steichen said Sauce Gardner suffered a left calf injury in Sunday's game against the Dolphins.
items.impact: Gardner is dealing with his third left calf injury since joining the Colts in a trade last year. His status on a short week on Thursday against the Texans is up in the air.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Charvarius Ward Sr. (shin) uncertain for Week 11
items.desc: Charvarius Ward Sr. is uncertain to be available for Thursday's game against the Texans.
items.impact: Ward is battling a shin injury. His status will need to be monitored in practice on a short week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Laremy Tunsil (triceps) making progress
items.desc: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn said doctors are pleased with the progress of Laremy Tunsil.
items.impact: Tunsil is slated to start the strength portion of his recovery. He remains uncertain to return this season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Denzel Perryman activated from IR
items.desc: The Chargers activated LB Denzel Perryman from injured reserve.
items.impact: Perryman will be good to go for Monday's game against the Ravens.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: David Njoku (fibula) activated from IR
items.desc: The Chargers activated TE David Njoku from injured reserve.
items.impact: Njoku will return for Monday's game against the Ravens. He remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Luther Burden III (concussion) practices Monday
items.desc: Luther Burden III was practicing on Monday.
items.impact: Burden left the Bears last game before their bye week with a concussion. He should be good to go, but he'll still need to be monitored in practice.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) practices Monday
items.desc: Kyle Monangai was practicing on Monday.
items.impact: Monangai will have a chance to return out of the bye week for the Bears. He will still need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brock Bowers (ankle) confirmed to be day-to-day
items.desc: Raiders head coach Klint Kubiak confirmed that Brock Bowers is day to day with his ankle injury.
items.impact: "It's not as bad as we thought, but still a significant injury," Kubiak said. Bowers is uncertain heading into Week 11 against the Broncos.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Micah Parsons (knee) trending towards Week 12 return
items.desc: Micah Parsons (knee) is trending toward returning in Week 12 for the Green Bay Packers according to Adam Schefter.
items.impact: Parsons still has "some hurdles to clear" according to Green Bay head coach Matt LaFleur, but barring any setbacks seems poised to return to the field on Thanksgiving Eve in a matchup against the Los Angeles Rams.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Geno Smith (ankle) to undergo MRI Monday
items.desc: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said Geno Smith will undergo an MRI on Monday.
items.impact: Smith left Sunday's game early against the Bills with an ankle injury. There should be an update on his status later this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: George Holani week-to-week with MCL sprain
items.desc: Seahawks RB George Holani suffered an MCL sprain and is considered to be week-to-week.
items.impact: Holani is hopeful to avoid a stint on injured reserve. He will be re-evaluated next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zach Ertz signs with Eagles active roster
items.desc: The Eagles signed TE Zach Ertz to their active roster.
items.impact: Ertz will continue to add depth in the tight end room for Philadelphia. He will remain off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jordan Addison (thumb) to likely go on short-term IR
items.desc: Vikings head coach Kevin O'Connell said Jordan Addison is expected to be placed on short-term IR.
items.impact: Addison has a thumb injury that's going to require surgery. He will likely miss at least a few weeks.

items.author: Kelly Kirby
items.title: Andrew Van Ginkel exits Week 10 with quad injury
items.desc: Vikings LB Andrew Van Ginkel left Sunday's 30-10 win over the Packers with a quad injury, according to ESPN's Kevin Seifert. He was last on the field with 26 seconds left in the third quarter, when he grabbed his right leg after a pass rush.
items.impact: Van Ginkel had three solo tackles, a sack, and a QB hit before he left. His Week 11 status is unclear until the Vikings release their first injury report of the week. If he misses time, Dallas Turner moves into a bigger role.

items.author: Kelly Kirby
items.title: Sam Darnold could return in Week 12
items.desc: Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald told Seattle Sports radio hosts Brock Huard and Mike Salk on Monday that the team is "really optimistic" QB Sam Darnold (quad) will get enough practice reps next week to start Nov. 29 against the 49ers, according to ESPN's Brady Henderson. Macdonald said Drew Lock has been great, "but Sam's our quarterback."
items.impact: Darnold has missed the last two games with a quad injury he suffered in Week 8 against the Bears, after also playing through a cracked rib. With Seattle on bye in Week 11, the extra week gives him more time to heal. Darnold could return as a QB2 against San Francisco if he practices fully next week. Lock remains a stash in superflex and 2QB leagues until Darnold's status is confirmed.

items.author: Kelly Kirby
items.title: Malik Willis' surgery decision still pending
items.desc: Dolphins coach Jeff Hafley said Monday that no decision has been made on whether QB Malik Willis (groin/core) needs surgery.
items.impact: Miami placed Willis on injured reserve last week after an MRI showed his lingering groin issue had become a core muscle injury. He'll miss at least three more games. The team expected him back before the season ended, but potential surgery puts that return in doubt. He is only worth holding in deep superflex and 2QB leagues until there's an update. Kyle McCord remains Miami's starter.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Cooper Rush signs with Tampa Bay practice squad
items.desc: Cooper Rush is signing with the Tampa Bay practice squad due to the injury to Baker Mayfield.
items.impact: With Mayfield dealing with a foot injury, the Bucs are bringing in Rush as extra depth. It's safe to assume Jalon Daniels would be the starter if Mayfield misses time, and Rush would be the backup in that situation.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DaRon Bland suffers ankle injury Sunday
items.desc: DaRon Bland left Sunday's game early against the 49ers with an ankle injury.
items.impact: The Cowboys are determining the extent of the injury for Bland.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zane Gonzalez waived by Dolphins
items.desc: The Dolphins waived kicker Zane Gonzalez.
items.impact: Gonzalez missed two field goals in Sunday's two point loss against the Colts. They will seek another kicker this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyler Booker suffers high ankle sprain
items.desc: Cowboys OG suffered a high-ankle sprain in Sunday's game against the 49ers.
items.impact: Booker is expected to miss at least the next four weeks. Rapoport notes that Booker suffered a similar injury kept him out three games last season.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Steelers D/ST dismal in loss Sunday
items.desc: The Steelers' D/ST logged one sack and allowed 38 points in Sunday's loss to the Cincinnati Bengals.
items.impact: Pittsburgh's defense was terrible on Sunday night. They allowed 38 points over the course of the game, and they weren't able to log many big plays to help out their own offense. This unit should bounce back in a favorable matchup against the Eagles next week, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chris Boswell perfect in loss Sunday
items.desc: Chris Boswell made his lone field-goal attempt and his lone extra-point attempt in Sunday's 38-18 loss to the Cincinnati Bengals.
items.impact: Boswell did his job on Sunday, making both of his kicks to rack up a total of four points. He wasn't able to put up a good fantasy performance, however, just because the Steelers' offense wasn't able to get him into scoring range on many occasions.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Drake Maye (ankle) out indefinitely
items.desc: The Patriots are concerned that QB Drake Maye fractured his ankle.
items.impact: Schefter notes that Maye remained in Germany to undergo additional testing to determine whether he needs surgery. He is feared to be out for the season.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Darnell Washington uninvolved in loss Sunday
items.desc: Darnell Washington caught 1-of-3 targets for five yards in Sunday's 38-18 loss to the Cincinnati Bengals.
items.impact: Washington didn't contribute much on Sunday. He caught just one pass for five yards over the course of the game, which left him with a poor fantasy total. He has week-to-week upside but won't be consistent moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Pat Freiermuth finds end zone Sunday
items.desc: Pat Freiermuth caught 2-of-3 targets for 35 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 38-18 loss to the Cincinnati Bengals.
items.impact: Freiermuth was a meaningful contributor for the Steelers on Sunday. He hauled in a touchdown on one of his two catches and racked up 35 yards in the process. He will continue to be fantasy relevant moving forward, although he's not immune from having bad games on a game-to-game basis.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Germie Bernard held without catch in loss Sunday
items.desc: Germie Bernard didn't haul in any of his three targets in Sunday's 38-18 loss to the Cincinnati Bengals.
items.impact: The rookie was locked down on Sunday night. He saw three targets over the course of the game but couldn't haul in any of them, leaving him with a goose egg in most categories on the stat sheet. He should not be started in any league formats for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Rico Dowdle quiet in loss Sunday
items.desc: Rico Dowdle rushed the ball five times for 26 yards and caught two passes for eight yards in Sunday's 38-18 loss to the Cincinnati Bengals.
items.impact: Dowdle wasn't effective on Sunday, finishing with just 34 scoreless yards on seven total touches. He will continue to see involvement in this offense moving forward but shouldn't be regarded as much more than a handcuff fantasy asset behind Jaylen Warren for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: DK Metcalf leads team in receiving Sunday
items.desc: DK Metcalf caught 2-of-6 targets for 54 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 38-18 loss to the Cincinnati Bengals.
items.impact: Metcalf ended the game with just two catches, but he was productive with them and was able to finish with 54 yards and a touchdown on the night. His fantasy total was decent in this matchup, but fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to be consistent on a game-to-game basis over the back half of the season.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jaylen Warren underwhelming in loss Sunday
items.desc: Jaylen Warren rushed the ball seven times for 15 yards and caught five passes for 26 yards in Sunday's 38-18 loss to the Cincinnati Bengals.
items.impact: Warren wasn't able to get much going on Sunday. He finished with just 15 yards on the ground, but his involvement in the passing game was able to pad his fantasy total in PPR scoring formats. He should bounce back and return to being a high-end fantasy option sometime in the very near future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Aaron Rodgers tosses two touchdowns in loss Sunday
items.desc: Aaron Rodgers completed 15-of-29 passing attempts for 143 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 38-18 loss to the Cincinnati Bengals.
items.impact: The Steelers weren't able to get it done on Sunday night, suffering a big loss at the hands of the Bengals. Rodgers had a decent performance in that game with two touchdowns and no turnovers, but he still made his fair share of mistakes and wasn't able to lead the offense to many points scored. Moving forward he should continue to be regarded as nothing more than a streaming option for fantasy purposes.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Bengals D/ST plays well in win Sunday
items.desc: The Bengals' D/ST logged three sacks and allowed just 18 points in Sunday's win over the Pittsburgh Steelers.
items.impact: Cincinnati's defense played great on Sunday night. They held the Steelers to just 18 points over the course of the game, though they weren't able to to log any turnovers in the process. This unit can be started in favorable matchups moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Evan McPherson scores seven points in win Sunday
items.desc: Evan McPherson went 5-for-5 on his extra-point attempts and 1-for-2 on his field-goal attempts in Sunday's 38-18 win over the Pittsburgh Steelers.
items.impact: McPherson scored seven points on Sunday night. He wasn't perfect, however, as he left three points on the field by missing one of his two field-goal attempts over the course of the game. He should continue to be a good fantasy option for the time being.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Drew Sample hauls in touchdown Sunday
items.desc: Drew Sample caught three passes for 15 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 38-18 win over the Pittsburgh Steelers.
items.impact: Sample was able to contribute well with three catches on Sunday, one of which ended up going for a touchdown. Still, fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to be a key part of this offense moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dohnte Meyers scores once in win Sunday
items.desc: Dohnte Meyers caught two passes for 20 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 38-18 win over the Pittsburgh Steelers.
items.impact: Meyers didn't see a lot of work on Sunday, but he was still able to leave his mark on the game by catching a touchdown on one of his two receptions. Fantasy managers shouldn't have high expectations for him moving forward, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Samaje Perine finds end zone in win Sunday
items.desc: Samaje Perine rushed the ball six times for 14 yards and a touchdown while adding four catches for 25 yards through the air in Sunday's 38-18 win over the Pittsburgh Steelers.
items.impact: Perine had himself a nice game on Sunday. He wasn't very productive on the ground, but he was able to make up for that by getting into the end zone once and getting involved in the receiving game. He will continue to see meaningful touches for this offense moving forward, though he won't be a good fantasy option as long as he's behind Chase Brown in the pecking order.
